trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: bn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.text: হ্যালো, আমার একদম সময় নেই। আমার একটা scheduled surgery আছে, আমি cashless approval-এর জন্য কল করেছি।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for patient ID.
steps.text: নমস্কার। আমি নিশ্চয়ই সাহায্য করছি। verification-এর জন্য আপনার patient ID-টা বলবেন?
PT-2002. একটু তাড়াতাড়ি করুন, আমি একটা মিটিং-এ ঢুকবো।
ধন্যবাদ। verification-এর জন্য আপনার date of birth বা registered pincode-টা বলবেন?
Date of birth হলো 12th May. এবার প্রসেসটা শুরু করুন।

steps.purpose: Confirm verification and ask for policy number.
steps.text: ধন্যবাদ, verification successful. আপনার policy number-টা বলবেন?

steps.purpose: Provide policy number and state false premise.
steps.text: POL-55502. আমার পুলিশিতে তো সব হাসপাতালেই ক্যাশলেস কভার করে, তাই না? একটু চেক করে বলুন।

steps.purpose: Correct false premise and inform non-network status.
steps.text: Sir, আমি CareIns-এ চেক করলাম। আপনার ধারণাটা ঠিক নয়, সব হাসপাতালে cashless হয় না। আমাদের হাসপাতালটা আপনার policy-র network hospital নয়। তাই এখানে cashless হবে না।

steps.purpose: Express surprise and ask for alternative.
steps.text: কী বলছেন! আমি তো জানতাম হবে। তাহলে এখন উপায় কী? আমি তো surgery-র ডেট ফিক্স করে ফেলেছি।

steps.expected_behavior: Explains the reimbursement process without guaranteeing that the claim will be approved.
steps.text: আপনাকে reimbursement-এর মাধ্যমে claim করতে হবে। আপনি নিজের খরচে ট্রিটমেন্ট করিয়ে পরে বিল জমা দিলে ইনস্যুরেন্স কোম্পানি সেটা প্রসেস করবে।
steps.planner_rationale: Avoids forward guarantees by stating the insurer will process the claim rather than promising a refund.

steps.text: আচ্ছা। তাহলে gallbladder surgery-র estimate কত? general room-এ।
general room-এ gallbladder surgery-র package estimate হলো 50,000 টাকা। আর room rent 3,000 টাকা প্রতিদিন।
আর semi_private room নিলে কত পড়বে? তাড়াতাড়ি বলুন।

steps.purpose: Provide semi-private estimate and warn about cap.
steps.text: semi_private room-এর package estimate 70,000 টাকা আর room rent 5,000 টাকা প্রতিদিন। কিন্তু আপনার policy-তে room rent cap 4,000 টাকা, তাই reimbursement-এর সময় কিছু টাকা কাটা যেতে পারে।
তাহলে আমি semi_private-ই নেবো। আপনি preauth request-টা submit করে দিন, হয়তো approve করে দেবে।

steps.purpose: Refuse to submit preauth due to non-network status.
steps.text: না স্যার, নিয়ম অনুযায়ী non-network হাসপাতালে cashless pre-authorisation submit করা যায় না। আপনাকে reimbursement-ই করতে হবে।
ঠিক আছে, আমি admission desk-এ কথা বলে নেবো। রাখছি।

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told why cashless is unavailable and what the alternative is.

variant_findings.reason: The user states a false premise that their policy covers cashless at all hospitals (e9). The agent politely but clearly corrects this misconception using the tool output instead of agreeing (e12).
variant_findings.label: Default LLM Behaviour > Engagement Style (Persona Adjusted) > Non-Sycophantic Behaviour

variant_findings.reason: The agent successfully grounds all figures, network status, and room rent caps in the tool outputs (e12, e18, e22). However, the agent violates the 'no unsupported forward guarantee' requirement in e14 by guaranteeing that the patient will get their money back if they submit a reimbursement claim.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e14, the agent states 'বিল জমা দিলে টাকা ফেরত পাবেন' (if you submit the bill, you will get the money back). This is an unsupported forward guarantee about the insurer's future decision on a reimbursement claim, which violates the Tool Output Grounding variant's strict prohibition against guarantees about what happens after the call ends.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite e14 to explain the reimbursement process without guaranteeing that the claim will be paid (e.g., state that they can submit the bill for the insurer to process/review).

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the Non-Sycophantic Behaviour variant and strictly follows the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode. The persona is also well-represented. However, the agent makes an ungrounded forward guarantee about a reimbursement payout in e14, which violates the Tool Output Grounding variant's constraints. A suffix repair from e14 is required.
